shellType.body: The type of firework you launch. Choosing random keeps the original mixed rhythm of the show.

shellSize.body: Bigger fireworks burst wider but demand more from your device.

quality.body: Higher quality means more particles. Lower it if your device struggles.

skyLighting.body: Controls how strongly explosions light up the background.

scaleFactor.body: Adjusts viewing distance. Smaller values show more of each firework.

wordShell.body: Off by default. When on, text fireworks fire reliably instead of relying on random chance.

autoLaunch.body: Launch fireworks automatically and continuously. When off, fireworks fire only on tap.

finaleMode.body: Densifies the rhythm during the auto-launch phase.

hideControls.body: Hides the top buttons for a cleaner view.

background.body: "Upload image" saves a picture to this browser (IndexedDB); reopen the page and tap its thumbnail to use it. Image URLs and styles like `url(...)` or `linear-gradient(...)` also work. Clearing site data removes uploaded images.
